acceptedHighFindings.rationale: On 2026-10-21 the human task owner explicitly approved indefinite acceptance of these two exact glibc High identities in the existing six repositories while authorizing completion of the online-submission correction release. Residual memory-corruption/service-crash risk remains and runtime unreachability is not established. All six exact candidate scans from failed release39552635486 were COMPLETE with only these two High identities and zero Critical; fresh scans remain mandatory for every new candidate. This approval does not cover other identities, packages, versions, repositories or Critical findings. Preserve native, scan, isolated development, preprod/termination, production approval, rolling, real-use and cleanup gates, and the existing glibc replacement/vulnerability-reproduction HOLD. Exact human approval and evidence: docs/operations/container-image-security.md#glibc-approval-20261021.
